notes.title: Small Fix
notes.content:
- This should be the conclusion for the Steam Cloud Update. 
 
 I've identified a rare inventory bug where the inventory may appear white if cloud save data becomes corrupted. I believe this issue is now fixed, but if you encounter it, starting a new game will resolve the problem.

For those who prefer not to start over, I am working on a solution that will allow you to empty and reset your inventory grid in-game. This fix should be available within a few hours, and no later than tomorrow. Additionally, I am adding a trash option to let you remove individual items from your inventory.

This should be a rare or not happen at all. 

Thank you for your patience!

tags.bug: - I've identified a rare inventory bug where the inventory may appear white if cloud save data becomes corrupted. I believe this issue is now fixed, but if you encounter it, starting a new game will resolve the problem.

notes.title: 6 Month Update!
notes.content:
[h2]                    🦀 Major Update Released! 🦀[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470197/412e9c0765d906e017d722cefc03fff0c26a59a0.png"][/img]Hey everyone!
A big new update is here, and while there’s still plenty to do, I wanted to get these changes into your hands to help with bug fixing and gather feedback from the community. Here’s an overview of what’s new, as well as a sneak peek at what’s coming next![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470197/827969620a8e53e1d666a28851ae1d6df924cecb.png"][/img]
[b]What’s New:[/b] [/p][p]New Tank Options[/p][p]New Decor, more interior decorations for your tank, plus, more coming soon![/p][p]Feeding System Overhaul - Manage food with a new inventory system and customize your crab’s diet.[/p][p]Rename Your Crab - Rename option is now available under Crab Stats. [/p][p]Updated Survival UI - See exactly how long your crab can survive with its current settings. [/p][p]Backyard Improvements - New updates and areas in the Backyard to explore. [/p][p]Dash Ability - Press R in the Backyard to dash! [/p][p]Desk Drawer - Drawers now open correctly. [/p][p]New Animations & Digging - Crabs have new animations and can dig for pearls in the tank. Pearls are found randomly, digging doesn’t always reward a pearl![/p][p]Inventory UI Overhaul [/p][p]Audio Fixes Sounds now properly respond to your settings.[/p][p]Improved first-person experience in Backyard Adventure. (Third-person is coming back soon.)[/p][p]Menu Improvements [/p][p]Leaderboard Functionality is improved, though still a work in progress.[/p][p]General Bug Fixes and Minor Additions[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470197/5f6ee59170ae9f85e3b15255ffbc81e3d5f77c41.png"][/img][b]What’s Next:[/b]
More sound improvements
Further Backyard updates
Notifications for item and XP collection
Unlockable items
Quests for you and your crab
Additional animations and crab actions
More achievements
Shell drops

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470197/a3dde3eb515c34490c128a9b61a03aae89a9e176.png"][/img][i][b]Thank you for your continued support! Your feedback is invaluable, so please share your thoughts and report any bugs you encounter. Let’s keep growing this project together![/b][/i]


[/p]

notes.title: Medium Update #1
notes.content:
[b] Crabs Update: Backyard Adventure Improvements & New Features!
[/b]
A new update is here! The [b]Backyard Adventure[/b] map has been expanded with several new points of interest, with even more surprises coming soon. Additionally, we’ve introduced an optional first-person mode, allowing you to switch between [b]first and third-person perspectives[/b] while controlling your crab. This update is being released early for testing, so please let us know if you encounter any issues or bugs!

Other Updates & Changes:
--New UI enhancements for a smoother experience.
--New leveling system with the ability to upgrade your crab’s stats.
--Stat improvements:
--Vitality affects health in Backyard Adventure.
--Agility affects your crab’s movement speed.
--Frog AI temporarily removed—it will return in the next update.
--Multiple improvements and refinements to the Backyard Adventure experience.

Looking ahead, the next update will focus on enhancing the Tank Life experience—including new ways to upgrade your crab’s home. Stay tuned!

Thank you for your support! Be sure to join our Discord if you have any suggestions or feedback.

tags.feature: --New UI enhancements for a smoother experience.
--New leveling system with the ability to upgrade your crab’s stats.
